articles.title: Sutton CC celebrates its 2026 award winners
articles.image_alt: Michael Grady receiving a Sutton Cricket Club 2026 award
articles.summary: Sutton Cricket Club celebrates the 2026 award winners across the 1st XI, 2nd XI, Sunday side, club awards and U14s.
articles.lead: Sutton Cricket Club has celebrated its 2026 award winners, recognising performances and contributions across the senior, Sunday, club and junior sections.
body: Michael Grady collected both the 1st XI Batter of the Year and Player of the Year awards, with Josh Grady named 1st XI Bowler of the Year.
For the 2nd XI, James Short was Batter of the Year, Michael Ward Bowler of the Year and Paul Robinson Player of the Year.
Kaiden Grady was named Sunday Player of the Year, Vini Vineeth Fielder of the Year, George Ware Clubman and Josh Pollard Young Player of the Year.
The U14 awards went to Leon Perrin as Batter of the Year, Jason Harnwell as Bowler of the Year and Oscar Pergl-Wilson as Player of the Year.
Congratulations to all of the 2026 winners, and thank you to everyone who contributed to Sutton Cricket Club throughout the season.

articles.title: £275 raised in memory of Colin Coulson
articles.summary: A memorial cricket match raised £275 for the British Heart Foundation in memory of Colin Coulson.
articles.lead: Players, friends and supporters came together for a memorial cricket match, raising £275 for the British Heart Foundation in memory of Colin Coulson.
body: The club would like to thank everyone who played, supported and contributed to the memorial match.
A total of £275 was raised for the British Heart Foundation in Colin’s memory.

articles.title: Sutton win by seven wickets
articles.summary: James Nuttall and Michael Grady led the chase after Telugu Association were restricted to 80.
articles.lead: Telugu Association were restricted to 80 before Sutton reached 81/3. James Nuttall scored 26 and Michael Grady finished 21 not out.
body: Sutton completed the chase for the loss of three wickets to secure a seven-wicket victory.

articles.title: Grady century powers Sutton to huge victory
articles.summary: Michael Grady hit an unbeaten 127 as Sutton posted 288/3 before dismissing Bluntisham for 87.
articles.lead: Michael Grady hit 127* as Sutton made 288/3. James Nuttall scored 80 and Richard Goodjohn 50*. Bluntisham were dismissed for 87 as Sutton won by 201 runs.
body: It was a dominant Sutton performance, with three major batting contributions setting up a 201-run victory.
